stem: A circle with centre M is drawn. Draw a straight line L1 passing through the centre of the circle and dividing it into two arcs. Drag the two ends of the segment onto the circle so that the line passes through M.
solution: The line L1 must pass through the centre M of the circle.
Place one end of the segment on the circle.
Place the other end on the circle on the opposite side so that M lies on the segment; the line then divides the circle into two arcs, and it is a diameter.

hints.text: Check whether your line passes through the centre M. Move one end round the circle until M lies on the segment.
Both ends of the segment must lie on the circle itself, not inside it or outside it. Drag each end until it sits on the circle.

notes: Part 2 asks for a line through the centre cutting the circle in two arcs; this is the diameter construction. Parts 1 (draw circle with compasses), 3 and 4 (fold and observe) are not covered.
